content: Linux evdev defines EV_KEY values 1 press, 0 release, and 2 autorepeat. Qualification can observe the exact keyboard through /dev/input/by-id or udev, require exactly one Space press and release, permit zero or more repeat events, and combine udev/evdev removal observation with lsusb and CDC traffic. The workstation has lsusb, udevadm, and libinput but not evtest.
